description: Converts value to boolean as ECMAScript Boolean() does with the value as JSON carries it: undefined and null are false; a boolean is itself; a number is false for 0, -0, and NaN; a value whose JSON form is a string (string, anyURI, dateTime, base64Binary, ...) is false only when that text is empty (so "false" and "0" are true); an object, array, or function is true.
